title: Kutsvaga Kwedare
intro: Munzira dzesimba, munhu ane chinzvimbo chepamusoro akafarira muranda ane runako rwakafanana nerwenyika. Kufarira uku kwakatungamira kune zviitiko zvakatevedzana zvaizoedza kuvimbika, kuburitsa chokwadi chakavanzika, uye pakupedzisira kusimbisa kusava nemhosva kwemuranda.
clues: Ndaigara munyika yeNire, mumuzinda une simba guru.
Jaya rakauya mumba mangu, uye kuvapo kwaro kwakavhiringidza nyika yangu.
Ndakaedza kumunyengedza, asi akatsvaga utiziro kuna Ishe wake.
Ndakabvarura nguo yake kubva kumashure, asi humbowo hwakaratidza kuti ndainyengera.
Kuti ndinyaradze makuhwa evakadzi vepamusoro, ndakavakoka kumusangano ndokuvaisa zvinhu zvakapinza mumaoko avo.
Pakupedzisira, ndakabvuma pachena mhosva yangu, ndichibvuma chokwadi pamberi pamambo.
arabic: قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ إِذْ رَٰوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۚ قُلْنَ حَـٰشَ لِلَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِن سُوٓءٍۢ ۚ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْـَٔـٰنَ حَصْحَصَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَنَا۠ رَٰوَدتُّهُۥ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: Said [the king to the women], "What was your condition when you sought to seduce Joseph?" They said, "Perfect is Allāh! We know about him no evil." The wife of al-ʿAzeez said, "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him, and indeed, he is of the truthful. (12:51)
